arm.role: the treatment column (knob-tail arm B, exk30)

comparator.role: context only, sealed, never re-flown; not read by the column passes

in_chain_replicate.role: the delivering arm's own first-visit column: the LEFT side of both contrasts

twin.role: the in-flight twin (replicate_of a-base): the right side of the null contrast

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim; Solver-local, never a system-level claim. No utterance text, transcript, gold label or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT COLUMN READ (owner decision 172; claim ceiling 'nominated', Q6 ruling). Every column -- a-base (the delivering arm's first-visit column), b-exk30 and t-twin -- is rendered from the sealed first Solver visit through the delivered row's normaliser and projection (the render refuses on any acceptance-test AT1 failure) and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch.score_complete_derived_copy; each contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260928). (1) THE TWIN NULL: t-twin minus a-base on official pooled SLU-F1 (primary) and intent accuracy (guard); the bar on each metric is |twin offset| + the twin's CI95 half-width (the same law as the cross-flight in-chain A/A), reported beside the provisional floor 0.3163 pp SLU / 0.0000 pp intent (scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py, design same-flight-supply-variant: 0.735 x sqrt(200 / 1080)). (2) THE KNOB: b-exk30 minus a-base. NOMINATED iff the SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the SLU-F1 point delta exceeds the twin bar AND the intent CI95 lower bound is not below minus the twin's intent bar. SOLVER-LOCAL HARM iff the SLU-F1 (or intent) CI95 upper bound is below zero and the point delta's magnitude exceeds that metric's twin bar. Otherwise NOT NOMINATED (within the twin null). A nomination claims nothing at system level: it only sends the exk30 construction to a full-system read against an in-chain A/A. The utterance-level number is reported beside the row-level one and never gates (Q4). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings.
steps: 0. Refuse unless the READ row SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-WSV1-FOLD-A-COLUMN-READ-V1 is root countersigned (checked by scripts/flights/wsv1/wsv1_read.sh before anything is opened).
1. Refuse unless the flight carries a COMPLETE sealed 1,080-row manifest with one successful complete official TRAIN score, the v3 supply-variant receipt on every row and I7v verified by the bundle.

2. Render the three first-visit columns (a-base, b-exk30, t-twin) through the delivered row's normaliser and projection (AT1 self-check) and score each ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --mode supply-variants).
3. Twin null: paired row bootstrap of t-twin minus a-base (SLU-F1 primary, intent guard) -> the bar per metric = |offset| + CI95 half-width; report it beside the provisional floor.
4. Knob: paired row bootstrap of b-exk30 minus a-base; apply the rule (NOMINATED / NOT NOMINATED / SOLVER-LOCAL HARM).

5. Report the per-scenario table in both weightings, the utterance-level number beside the row-level one, the realised per-arm supplied item counts against the declared bounds, and the realised prompt tokens per arm.
